headline: More than 9,300 leaked AWS keys sit live in the wild and a new phishing kit plants attacker-controlled passkeys, showing that stolen credentials now outlast every password reset.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers increasingly prize durable credentials: more than 9,300 exposed AWS keys stay valid for years, and the iAuthFlow V2 kit registers rogue passkeys that survive password resets and revoked sessions.

Financially motivated malware keeps colonizing new platforms, with the Grandoreiro trojan draining bank accounts across Latin America and Europe and fresh code hijacking Android car head units for ad fraud and proxy relays.

The Russia-Ukraine war keeps spilling into networks, as the pro-Ukraine group Black Spark spent more than a month inside Russian monitoring firm Microolap and reached its EtherSensor traffic-analysis platform.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Pro-Ukraine Group Black Spark Breaches Microolap

topics.title: Grandoreiro Banking Trojan Campaign
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek on August 22, 2026 spotlighted a persistent Grandoreiro banking-trojan campaign running across Latin America and Europe, joining the spyware-equipped Manic and the expanded ToxicPanda 2.0 documented earlier this week.
topics.summary: Grandoreiro is a long-running Latin American banking trojan that steals online-banking credentials and now strikes European victims. Banks and users should watch for malicious installer lures and enforce transaction verification.

sources.title: Banking Trojans Manic, Grandoreiro, ToxicPanda 2.0 in the Spotlight

topics.title: Thousands of Leaked AWS Keys Remain Active
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer reported on August 21, 2026 that more than 9,300 AWS access keys exposed publicly between August 2022 and August 2026 stay active and valid, granting anyone who finds them full control over corporate accounts, as Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 warned that attackers now hit CI/CD pipelines and developer tools rather than application code.
topics.summary: Developers leak long-lived AWS keys in public repositories, build artifacts, and code, and the keys open broad access to cloud accounts. Rotate exposed keys, move to short-lived credentials, and scan pipelines and artifacts for secrets.

sources.title: Hundreds of leaked AWS keys give full control over corporate accounts
Connecting the Dots: Securing the Overlooked Corners of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Supply Chain

topics.title: Pro-Ukraine Group Black Spark Breaches Microolap
topics.latest_developments: Microolap confirmed on August 21, 2026 the cyberattack that the pro-Ukraine group Black Spark claimed a day earlier, saying intruders spent more than a month inside its network and reached internal systems including EtherSensor, its network traffic-analysis platform.
topics.summary: Black Spark, a pro-Ukraine hacking crew, penetrated Russian network-monitoring vendor Microolap and accessed its EtherSensor traffic-analysis product. The intrusion pushes the cyber front of the Russia-Ukraine war into Russian security-tooling suppliers.

sources.title: Russian network monitoring firm confirms cyberattack claimed by pro-Ukraine hackers

topics.title: iAuthFlow V2 Registers Attacker Passkeys
topics.latest_developments: Researchers detailed iAuthFlow V2, a phishing toolkit that registers an attacker-controlled passkey during the login flow, granting persistent access that survives password changes and revoked sessions.
topics.summary: iAuthFlow V2 abuses passkey enrollment to hold a foothold after victims reset credentials. Defenders should audit passkey and security-key registrations and alert on any new authenticator enrollment.

sources.title: New Phishing Toolkit Uses Passkeys to Maintain Access After Password Resets

topics.title: Android Car Head-Unit Malware
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News reported on August 21, 2026 that Kaspersky, which found the threat in June 2026, detailed a new malware family infecting Android vehicle head-unit firmware built by DoFun, spreading through the units' built-in updaters to deliver a multi-stage downloader for ad fraud and a proxy botnet.
topics.summary: The malware rides DoFun-made Android head-unit firmware updaters in vehicles, then pulls payloads that commit ad fraud and enroll the units into a proxy botnet. Automakers and integrators should vet head-unit update channels and firmware sources.

sources.title: Android Car Malware Spreads Through Built-In Updaters for Ad Fraud, Proxy Botnet

topics.title: Lawmakers Probe CISA Staffing Cuts
topics.latest_developments: U.S. lawmakers on August 21, 2026 called for an investigation into how staffing cuts at the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency have affected its mission, saying little is known about the lost expertise or whether the agency has replaced it.
topics.summary: Members of Congress want a formal review of CISA workforce reductions and their operational fallout. The push raises concern that thinned staffing weakens federal cyberdefense coordination.

sources.title: Lawmakers call for investigation into impact of CISA staffing cuts

business_politics.title: U.S. Slaps 50% Tariffs on Canadian Goods
business_politics.latest_developments: The 50% tariffs took effect early Saturday, August 22, after negotiations collapsed Friday night, and Ottawa immediately promised matching duties on American products.
business_politics.summary: The United States imposed 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion of Canadian goods after last-ditch talks failed; Prime Minister Mark Carney rejected the terms as unfair, and Canada vowed retaliatory tariffs on U.S. imports, deepening the rupture between the two allies.

sources.title: U.S. Imposes 50% Tariffs on Some Canadian Goods After Last-Ditch Talks Fail
Canada vows to match US tariffs as trade talks collapse

business.title: Okane Opens Downtown
business.latest_developments: Okane, a three-story Japanese restaurant, opened in Downtown Pittsburgh on August 15 and hosted a preview of its rooftop menu.
business.summary: Okane, a new three-story Japanese restaurant, opened Downtown, serving dishes such as a salmon "cigar" on its rooftop level, adding to the city center's dining scene.

sources.title: New 3-story Japanese restaurant Okane opens in Downtown Pittsburgh

business.title: Contractors React to Data-Center Order
business.latest_developments: Western Pennsylvania developers and officials weighed in on Governor Josh Shapiro's executive order restricting data centers, and contractor Alex Paris said he is not much concerned.
business.summary: Governor Josh Shapiro's executive order imposing statewide guardrails on data-center development drew reaction across Western Pennsylvania from builders, local officials, and environmental groups, with contractor Alex Paris downplaying its effect on his projects.

sources.title: Local people react to Gov. Shapiro's executive order on data centers

around_town.title: Democrat Takes Butler County Seat
around_town.latest_developments: Days after the special election, residents and analysts debated whether Democrat Brandon Dukes's win over Republican Scott Timko in traditionally Republican Butler County signals a broader shift.
around_town.summary: Democrat Brandon Dukes captured a Pennsylvania House seat centered on Cranberry Township, Butler County, defeating Republican Scott Timko in a deep-red area, an upset locals like Susan Collier read as a possible sign of changing politics.

sources.title: Democratic upset in red Butler County could point to broader political shifts

around_town.title: Families Fear for Special Education in Closures
around_town.latest_developments: Parents told TribLive that Pittsburgh Public Schools' proposed school-closures plan could disrupt special education services their children depend on.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh Public Schools' plan to close buildings drew warnings from families that special education services would suffer, with one parent noting a child who can go from mildly sniffly to hospitalized within a single day.

sources.title: Special education services could suffer in Pittsburgh Public's school closures plan, families say

around_town.title: West Mifflin Bus Rides Run Over an Hour
around_town.latest_developments: In the first days of the school year, West Mifflin Area School District parents complained of bus rides stretching beyond an hour.
around_town.summary: Transportation troubles hit the opening days of school in the West Mifflin Area School District, where parents said students endured bus rides exceeding an hour.

sources.title: West Mifflin School District parents concerned after students endure bus rides exceeding an hour

around_teams.title: Steelers Sort Out the Quarterback Room
around_teams.latest_developments: Coach Mike McCarthy said he has seen enough of Mason Rudolph and set his quarterback plan for the preseason finale against the Buffalo Bills, while Post-Gazette columnist Noah Hiles argued keeping four quarterbacks would be a mistake.
around_teams.summary: The Steelers hold Aaron Rodgers, veteran Mason Rudolph, and young passers Will Howard and Drew Allar; Howard and Allar struggled in the preseason loss to the New York Jets, though McCarthy said that will not alter how he evaluates them heading into the finale.

sources.title: Noah Hiles: The Steelers would be wrong to roster four quarterbacks in 2026
Steelers' shutout loss doesn't change plans for Will Howard, Drew Allar

around_teams.title: Cherington Era Nears 1,000 Games
around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette analysis marks general manager Ben Cherington approaching 1,000 games running the Pirates and traces the seven losing seasons under owner Bob Nutting.
around_teams.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates are about to reach 1,000 games under general manager Ben Cherington, hired in 2019, a stretch of seven straight losing campaigns that the Post-Gazette broke down season by season.

sources.title: The Pirates' Ben Cherington era is about to hit 1,000 games. Here's how 7 seasons of losing unfolded.

around_teams.latest_developments: Cam Heyward's "Not Just Football" posted the second episode of its training-camp series, featuring defensive tackles Keeanu Benton and Sebastian Joseph-Day.
around_teams.summary: On "Not Just Football," Steelers captain Cam Heyward and co-host Hayden welcomed defensive linemen Keeanu Benton and Sebastian Joseph-Day to talk about the coming season and camp.
